title: Director Production
text:
**Job Summary**
Responsible for the leadership of the department managers within the processing facility including cut, prep, packaging, and warehouse. Stay involved in the process and have a good understanding of the departments' needs such as systems, staffing, and equipment. Other areas of responsibility are food safety, employee safety, fielding employee and customer complaints and ensure high-quality cuts at the highest possible yield along with maximizing pounds per man-hour.
 
 
**Responsibilities**

* Responsible for managing plant production and working with management to ensure the continual operational improvement of efficiencies and effectiveness of the company.
* Coordinate with all departments within the organization to establish and carry out operational challenges.
* Direct, monitor and appraise the performance of all areas immediately reporting and provide direction on areas of concern or new tasks.
* Maintain qualified personnel in positions that report directly and recommend compensation for all production employees.
* Participates as part of the management team to develop business strategies, company policy, and company direction.
* Provide input and leadership on decision-making issues, review and approve costs in labor, equipment, supplies and other areas as they relate to the overall operation.
* Work with customers, sales, and merchandising functions on product development and building meat knowledge.
* Assist with customer and field sales inquiries to offer solutions to resolve problems.
* Provide analysis to president as requested.
* Approve major projects or personal changes within the production facility.
* Give a reason for the expenditure include the benefits the new equipment will bring to the facility and an estimated pay off time based on studies leading to the decision for purchase.

**Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor’s preferred

**Experience**

* Four years of Meat processing background

**Professional Skills**

* Leadership skills
